desc_en: An essential knitted garment defined by its relaxed silhouette. The design features a classic crew neck with contrasting ribbed finishes on the collar, cuffs, and hem. Crafted with attention to detail, this sweater combines comfort and modern sophistication for the everyday wardrobe. Available made to order with worldwide shipping.

Confeccionado con atención al detalle, este jersey combina comodidad y sofisticación moderna para el fondo de armario diario. Disponible bajo pedido con envío a todo el mundo.
